meta.name: x-search
meta.description: MUST read before searching X/Twitter with the x_search tool. When xAI is connected: date-bound every time-sensitive query (from_date >= yesterday, widen to 7 days), scope trusted accounts with allowed_x_handles, phrase queries as latest/recent with since:/from:/filter: operators, split into 2-3 searches by account and by keyword, and reconcile against web_search. Triggers: X search, Twitter search, tweets, posts on X, what people are saying on X, x_search, social signal.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 锁定最新日期与可信账号，精准搜出X上的相关推文
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果常在X上搜索话题，并希望只看最新、来自可信账号的说法。
copy.tagline_en: Find the latest, trustworthy X posts using date and trusted-account filters.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you search X for topics and want up-to-date, credible takes from trusted accounts.

howto.what: 技能会在连接了 xAI 账号时,协助你搜索 X/Twitter:把提问处理成带日期范围和操作符的精确查询,分别按账号、关键词搜索,并把结果与网页搜索对照后汇报。
howto.when: 当你需要搜索 X、Twitter 上的推文或帖子,或询问“大家在 X 上说什么”时触发。

say.text: 搜一下今天大家怎么看英伟达财报
say.note: 会按账号和关键词分两次搜索并标注来源

say.text: 看看 @growth_papa 最近对 AI 芯片说了什么
say.note: 会把该账号加入可信范围,只搜它的帖子

say.text: 查一下最近三天关于“固态电池”的英文讨论
say.note: 会限定日期、过滤回复并只搜英文帖子

howto.what_en: When an xAI credential is connected, this skill helps you search X/Twitter: it turns your question into a dated query with operators, runs searches by account and by keyword, and reconciles results against web search before reporting.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask to search X or Twitter for tweets or posts, or ask what people are saying on X.

say_en.text: Search what people are saying today about Nvidia earnings.
say_en.note: Splits into account and keyword passes, cites sources.

say_en.text: What has @growth_papa said lately about AI chips?
say_en.note: Trusts that account and searches only its posts.

say_en.text: Find English discussion on solid-state batteries in the last 3 days.
say_en.note: Narrows dates, filters replies, restricts to English.
